# Tools

Interactive browser tools. **One folder per tool** under `tools/`.

```
tools/
  index.html      ← hub (/tools/)
  chroma/         ← Chroma Lab
  <next-tool>/    ← add more here
```

| Tool | Path | Live |
|------|------|------|
| Hub | `tools/` | https://lemoon01110.github.io/tools/ |
| Chroma Lab | `tools/chroma/` | https://lemoon01110.github.io/tools/chroma/ |
